intro.es: Lee un texto argumentativo y distingue la idea principal de sus condiciones y límites.

mission.es: Identifica la propuesta, sus ventajas y el problema que podría hacerla fracasar.

content.targetText: The town's new "library of things" lends tools, kitchen equipment and camping gear instead of books. Supporters say that borrowing a drill once a year is cheaper and less wasteful than buying one. The first month seemed to prove them right: over three hundred objects were borrowed, and the waiting list for sewing machines grew quickly. Yet the figures hide a problem. Most borrowers live near the centre, while residents on the outer estates would have to take two buses to return a heavy object. The organisers therefore propose collection points in three neighbourhoods. That costs money, and the council has offered funding for only six months. A volunteer suggests charging late fees, but the team worries that a strict fine would exclude the families the project was meant to serve. They are testing reminders and flexible returns instead. Success will depend less on how many drills are borrowed this winter than on whether people who currently cannot reach the service can use it next year.

objectives.es: Distinguir lo explícito de lo implícito y justificar cada respuesta con el texto.

targetCanDo.es: Puedes seguir un argumento y reconocer condiciones, evidencia y reservas.
